items.title: Stars as Black Body Radiators (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Stars as Black Body Radiators: a main subheading of 21.4 Blackbody Radiation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 173-173.

blocks.text: Sooraj jaise stars blackbody radiator ki tarah kaam karte hain. Yeh nuclear fusion (halke nuclei ka mil kar bhari nucleus banana) se apni energy khud banate hain, aur yeh energy electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein space mein phailti hai. Star ki radiation wavelengths ki bari range mein hoti hai aur aik continuous spectrum (beech mein koi khali jagah nahi) banati hai. Yeh spectrum blackbody spectrum jaisa hota hai. Spectrum study kar ke scientists star ki surface ka temperature theek theek andaza laga lete hain. Har star ka apna spectrum hai, is liye har star ki surface ka temperature bhi alag hai.
